name: @ionic-enterprise/ssl-pinning
description: Provide SSL pinning for Capacitor Native HTTP Plugin
author: Ionic Team

scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:ios && pnpm run verify:android && pnpm run verify:web
scripts.verify:ios: cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Plugin.xcworkspace -scheme Plugin -destination generic/platform=iOS && cd ..
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.lint: pnpm run eslint . --ext ts && pnpm run prettier "**/*.{css,html,ts,js,java}" --check && pnpm run swiftlint -- lint
scripts.fmt: pnpm run eslint . --ext ts --fix && pnpm run prettier "**/*.{css,html,ts,js,java}" --write && pnpm run swiftlint -- --fix --format
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run docgen && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.js
